tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: The correct option with respect to the Pauling electronegativity values of the elements is:

solution.text:
Correct order of electronegativity values of the elements is

$\mathrm{Si}>\mathrm{Al} ; \mathrm{S}>\mathrm{P} ; \mathrm{Se}>\mathrm{Te} ; \mathrm{Ge}>\mathrm{Ga}$
